season.evidence: Web search: SummitPost-type guides call it a summer and fall climb, snow gone by late August, axe only in early season; Mountaineers profile uses standard scramble gear. Ascent histogram peaks Jul-Sep.

track.why: Our catalog holds exactly one route on the peak, and the August 30 track follows its described line: Stehekin valley, Devore Creek trail, Bird Creek camp area, bushwhack to the south-west basin, talus to the summit (9 m from our pin), and back the same way. Start and end are about 570-640 m east of our Harlequin Bridge pin along the valley road (the airstrip end), so the mechanical 300 m check fails.

otherTracksConsidered.why: May 24 ascent on continuous snow, more than a month before the season starts.

facts.text: By the start of September the last slope to the summit is straightforward with little loose rock.

notes: Trailhead pin not moved: the harlequin-bridge coordinate could not be confirmed from a fetched page (OSM had no result), and the recordings only suggest the road end near the airstrip. Apply script may need to relax the 300 m start rule for this one or the owner can decide. The September 2024 report approached from Holden over Tenmile Pass, a different approach.
